record.original_question: The function  z + 1 z3  ∞ X 1 k(z) = 2Re 3 = (2n2 + 1)r n (einθ + e−inθ ), (1 − z)3 3 n=1 where z = reiθ , lies in the closure of SH . Prove that k is extremal for the coefficient bounds in SH . It is known by Clunie and Sheil-Small [167] that |an | < 13 (2n2 + 1) for functions in SH with real coefficients, and that |an | ≤ 13 (2n2 + 1) for functions in SH for which the domain f (D) is close-to-convex. (T. Sheil-Small)

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$. A complex-valued harmonic function $f$ on $\mathbb{D}$ admits a unique decomposition $f=h+\overline{g}$ where $h$ and $g$ are analytic in $\mathbb{D}$. Let $S_H$ denote the class of all such $f$ that are univalent and sense-preserving on $\mathbb{D}$, normalized by $h(0)=0$, $g(0)=0$, $h'(0)=1$. Write the series expansions $h(z)=z+\sum_{n=2}^\infty a_n z^n$ and $g(z)=\sum_{n=1}^\infty b_n z^n$, and let $\overline{S_H}$ denote the closure of $S_H$ with respect to locally uniform convergence on $\mathbb{D}$.

Define the harmonic function
$$k(z)=2\,\mathrm{Re}\!\left(\frac{z+\tfrac{1}{3}z^3}{(1-z)^3}\right)=\sum_{n=1}^{\infty}\frac{2n^{2}+1}{3}\,r^{n}\bigl(e^{in\theta}+e^{-in\theta}\bigr),\qquad z=re^{i\theta}.$$

It is known that $k\in\overline{S_H}$. Prove that $k$ is extremal for the coefficient bounds in $S_H$; that is, show that for every $f=h+\overline{g}\in S_H$ with coefficients $a_n,b_n$ as above and for every $n\ge 2$,
$$|a_n|+|b_n|\le \frac{2n^{2}+1}{3},$$
and more generally that the coefficient functionals on $S_H$ are maximized by $k$ (in particular $|a_n|\le \tfrac{(n+1)(2n+1)}{6}$ and $|b_n|\le \tfrac{(n-1)(2n-1)}{6}$).
artifact.status_search_result: The coefficient conjecture of Clunie and Sheil-Small for the class S_H of univalent sense-preserving harmonic mappings, asserting that the harmonic Koebe function k is extremal, remains an active open problem in geometric function theory. It has been verified in subclasses (starlike, typically real, close-to-convex, and harmonic mappings with real coefficients), and recent (2024–2026) arXiv preprints continue to investigate, refine, and produce partial results, indicating the full conjecture is not yet resolved.

status_evidence.title: Note on the Coefficient Conjecture of Clunie and Sheil-Small on the univalent harmonic mapping
status_evidence.snippet: present the counterexample to validate the coefficient conjecture proposed by Clunie and Sheil-Small ... improve the conjecture bounds of class S_H
status_evidence.claim: As of 2026 the Clunie–Sheil-Small coefficient conjecture for S_H is still being actively studied and not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: On Koebe radius and coefficients estimate for univalent harmonic mappings
status_evidence.snippet: coefficient bounds for harmonic univalent mappings ... harmonic Koebe function plays the extremal role
status_evidence.claim: Coefficient bounds for S_H with harmonic Koebe extremal are still investigated as open problems.
